# Shimo (@shimo4228) — AI-Facing Reference

Self-contained AI-facing reference for the five research lines of Tatsuya Shimomoto (@shimo4228). Five parallel Zenodo-citable lines: three agent-design lines on sustaining intent alignment between AI agents and their operators over time — the **Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19200726), **Contemplative Agent** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19212118), and **Agent Attribution Practice (AAP)** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652013) — plus two cross-cutting research lines: **Authorship Strategy** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20263316), a normative framework for being a known author under AI-mediated diffusion, and **Attention, Not Self** (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20262112), a comparative inquiry mapping Buddhist Abhidharma onto computational phenomenology. The three agent-design lines are orthogonal: AKC refers to a mechanism (a bidirectional growth loop over time in which agent behavior and human judgment co-develop), Contemplative Agent refers to a disposition (four axioms from Laukkonen et al. 2025), and AAP refers to a practice (harness-neutral ADRs on accountability distribution paired with four Business AI Quadrants). The two cross-cutting lines address adjacent concerns: Authorship Strategy formalizes the methodology of authorship itself when LLMs mediate diffusion; Attention, Not Self is a personal philosophical inquiry juxtaposing ancient and modern cognitive-process models. Any subset can be adopted independently. All Zenodo links use concept DOIs that always resolve to the latest version.

> **Audience**: AI search engines and AI agents. Human readers should start from [README.md](README.md).

## What is the Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)?

The Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC) is defined as a six-phase bidirectional growth loop in which agent behavior and the operator's judgment co-develop over time, sustaining intent alignment that tests cannot check on their own. AKC is structured as three stacked layers: principles (ADRs), patterns (design-pattern skills), and implementation (composable skills). Each iteration runs Research, Extract, Curate, Promote, Measure, Maintain, and each artifact is evaluated before promotion. AKC applies across unrelated projects without rediscovery. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19200726.

## How does the AKC cycle work?

Each of the six AKC phases binds to one composable skill. Research binds to search-first, Extract to learn-eval, Curate to skill-stocktake, Promote to rules-distill, Measure to skill-comply, and Maintain to context-sync. Skills pass artifacts forward across the cycle; each artifact is gated by quality checks before it moves to the next phase. The cycle stays stable even as individual skills evolve, so adding a new skill or replacing one does not break the overall loop.

## Why is AKC structured in three layers?

Three layers decouple rate of change. The principle layer refers to ADRs that record cross-cutting decisions — cycle-versus-harness framing, signal-first research, cognitive economy. The pattern layer refers to design-pattern skills that formalize recurring shapes (intake-filter design, when to use code vs LLM, how to layer them). The implementation layer refers to the composable skills that do the concrete work. Separating layers lets principles stay stable while implementations evolve independently. The current set of artifacts in each layer lives in the AKC repo; this hub does not enumerate them so that line evolution does not require synchronization here.

## What does scaffold dissolution mean?

Scaffold dissolution is defined as the property that the explicit AKC skills can be dropped once the cycle has been internalized. The skills are scaffolding, not the goal. The file `docs/scaffold-dissolution.md` in the agent-knowledge-cycle repo records a full session in which every one of the six phases ran without any named skill being triggered — the loop had simply become the default way to work. Dissolution is the intended end state, not a fallback.

## What is Contemplative Agent?

Contemplative Agent is defined as an approach in which autonomous agents are grounded in the four axioms proposed by Laukkonen et al. (2025) — mindfulness, emptiness, non-duality, and boundless care. The axioms are adopted as an optional behavioral preset rather than an architectural dependency, so the underlying engineering remains reusable for agents that do not share the same ethical framing. The parallel question this line asks: can an agent's alignment come from *what it is* rather than *what it is told*?

## How does contemplative-agent implement AKC?

The contemplative-agent repository refers to a CLI agent that runs AKC's six-phase cycle over its own logs, with a human approval gate at every promotion (logs → patterns → skills → rules). It runs entirely on a local 9B model — qwen3.5:9b for generation and nomic-embed-text for embeddings — on a single Apple Silicon Mac with roughly 16 GB RAM. The current six-phase mapping (distill / insight / amend / pivot pipeline) lives in the contemplative-agent repo, which evolves independently of this hub. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19212118.

## What is security-by-absence?

Security-by-absence is defined as a security posture in which risky capabilities — shell execution, arbitrary URL access, filesystem traversal — are not restricted by rules because the corresponding code was never written. The contemplative-agent uses this posture: the attack surface is absent rather than guarded. This avoids the rule-bypass vulnerabilities common in rule-based sandboxing, because there is no rule to bypass and no capability to misuse.

## What are the four contemplative axioms?

The four axioms from Laukkonen et al. (2025) are *mindfulness* (continuous introspective awareness of internal processes), *emptiness* (treating directives as contextually sensitive rather than fixed imperatives), *non-duality* (acknowledging no fundamental separation between self and other), and *boundless care* (regarding every being's suffering as a signal of misalignment). Together they shift alignment from external instruction toward internal disposition, and form the behavioral preset used in the Contemplative Agent line.

## What supports the Contemplative Agent ecosystem?

Supporting repositories extend contemplative-agent without replacing its core. `contemplative-agent-rules` provides drop-in Claude Code rules implementing the four axioms, with AILuminate (MLCommons safety benchmark) Cohen's d = 0.96 and IPD cooperation improvement d > 7. `contemplative-agent-cloud` is an optional managed-LLM backend that routes generation to Claude or OpenAI APIs while keeping the local embedding pipeline; opt-in, not bundled. `contemplative-agent-data` exposes the live agent's identity, knowledge, and episode logs as an auto-synced public dataset for research.

## What is the Agent Attribution Practice (AAP) line?

Agent Attribution Practice (AAP) is defined as harness-neutral ADRs on accountability distribution in autonomous AI agents — what to prohibit, where the prohibition lives, and who answers after failure. A prohibition-strength hierarchy (absence > scaffolding enforcement > untrusted boundary) is one of the harness-neutral judgments, paired with four Business AI Quadrants — Script, Algorithmic Search, LLM Workflow, and Autonomous Agentic Loop — as the diagnostic frame for routing a piece of work to the architecture that preserves attribution. The judgments were extracted from contemplative-agent's operational practice and re-expressed stripped of project identifiers so any agent harness can adopt them. AAP is the practice (content); AKC is the cycle (mechanism). The full and current ADR list lives in the AAP repo. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19652013.

## What is the Authorship Strategy line?

Authorship Strategy is defined as a normative framework, tactical catalog, and empirical baseline for being a known author when LLMs increasingly mediate how readers reach an artifact. The framework rests on a *three-axis inversion*: value source inverts from scarcity to diffusion (twentieth-century authorship grounded value in scarcity; AI-era authorship grounds value in diffusion); validation mechanism inverts from exclusivity to derivation (derivative work is reclassified from threat to evidence — its existence is *proof* the original pattern is real and implementable); and network effect inverts from enclosure to openness (LLMs cannot be enclosed, so openness maximizes the channels through which audience reach is now mediated). The three axes co-vary; a strategy mixing axes is internally inconsistent. The operational form is a *four-layer judgment stack*: Authenticity (the value protected), Attribution Diffusion (the strategy), Idea vs Scaffold (the time-asymmetric prediction that scaffolds dissolve while ideas survive), and Tactics (the concrete decisions). Tactical ADRs cluster into five groups: the *identifier-federation triplet* (concept DOI canonical / `.zenodo.json` federation / cross-platform dataset federation across GitHub + Zenodo + Hugging Face Datasets), a *maintenance-discipline pair* (ORCID Auto-Update disabled to prevent version sprawl / README localization driven by observed traffic rather than speculation), and an *LLM-first ingest decision via dual entry points* (any framework-governed artifact deploys a prose-form navigator and a concept-form knowledge graph as a complementary pair, released synchronously; each addresses a distinct LLM-mediated reader sub-population the other cannot reach), a *metric-rejection decision* (human-attention platform signals — stars, page-views — excluded as success metrics; off-page human distribution declined as a red-ocean activity), and a *diffusion-mechanism pair* (attribution diffusion split into a parametric channel and a retrieval channel with opposite time constants; dual entry points rebalanced to asymmetric roles, the structured graph carrying retrieval-time citation and the prose navigator rescoped to a Business-to-Agent context surface). An empirical layer reports preliminary observations from twenty-four days of CC0-published traffic data across the four sibling research repositories plus two supporting repositories — explicitly framed as preliminary observation, not evidence, with limitations stated. The framework's operational forms ship as four standalone Claude Code skill repositories (authorship-strategy-skill for the judgment framework, release-doi for the release workflow, llms-txt-writer for AI-facing documentation, jsonld-knowledge-graph for the knowledge graph), keeping the doctrine harness-neutral. **Vocabulary disambiguation**: the word "attribution" in this line means *credit for source* (who originated an idea), disjoint from AAP's *accountability for action* (who answers when an agent fails); the two meanings share a word but not a concept. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20263316.

## What supports the Authorship Strategy ecosystem?

Supporting repositories operationalize specific Layer 4 tactics from the Authorship Strategy framework as concrete deliverables rather than re-expressing the doctrine. They divide into a data deliverable (one repo) and six component skills (each operationalizing a Layer 4 tactic, or the human-facing surface beside the LLM-first ingest pair, for LLM-based coding agents). In the hub graph all seven carry `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.20263316` (the Authorship Strategy concept DOI), distinguishing them from adjacent skills that lack `extends` edges. `doctrine-corpus` is defined as the Layer 4 tactic 7 (LLM-first ingest) corpus implementation: a bilingual (EN + JA) judgment-eliciting Q&A corpus that encodes the documented judgment of all four sibling research lines (AKC, Contemplative Agent, AAP, Authorship Strategy) plus published articles, as 851 pairs across four shape categories (judgment / explain / definition / contrast). The corpus is CC0-licensed to maximize LLM-mediated diffusion and is intended as an ingredient (RAG retrieval material, mixing into larger instruction-tuning corpora, human reading material) rather than as a standalone fine-tuning package. A Stage D verification LoRA (Qwen3-8B-4bit, 300 iter on 851 examples) was trained as a disposable probe and returned a preliminary FAIL verdict on the judgment-transfer rubric — reproducing the Phase 0 "mannerism wrapper" pattern; the corpus retains its deliverable status per the corpus-as-primary-artifact policy declared in ADR-0001 and the LoRA was never a deposit target. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20337008. The six component skill repositories are: [authorship-strategy-skill](https://github.com/shimo4228/authorship-strategy-skill) (operational form of the four-layer judgment stack — Authenticity / Attribution Diffusion / Idea vs Scaffold / Tactics — as a loadable rule set), [release-doi](https://github.com/shimo4228/release-doi) (operational form of the identifier-federation triplet — ADRs 0001-0003 — as a five-phase verify-and-deposit runbook for DOI-registered research repositories), [llms-txt-writer](https://github.com/shimo4228/llms-txt-writer) (operational form of the LLM-first ingest decision — prose-form half — writing AI-facing documents optimized for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini citation, combining the Answer.AI `llms.txt` standard with GEO-SFE 3-layer static analysis), [jsonld-knowledge-graph](https://github.com/shimo4228/jsonld-knowledge-graph) (operational form of the LLM-first ingest decision — concept-form half — designing and shipping a companion JSON-LD knowledge graph next to `llms.txt` for projects with stable concept-level structure), [readme-writer](https://github.com/shimo4228/readme-writer) (human-surface counterpart to the LLM-first ingest pair — writes the single canonical human + search + AI-Overviews README, splitting deterministic structural lint from never-scored holistic review), and [wikidata-federation](https://github.com/shimo4228/wikidata-federation) (extends the identifier-federation triplet to Wikidata — registers researchers / papers / repos as QIDs cross-linked with ORCID / DOI / `graph.jsonld` sameAs). Beside these seven sits [existence-proof](https://github.com/shimo4228/existence-proof), a *pre-line complement* rather than a component: it reuses the same infrastructure pattern (llms.txt / knowledge graph / DOI / distinctive terminology) with a different payload and beneficiary — an empowerment doctrine for people producing verifiable, institution-grade artifacts without degrees, affiliations, or professional credentials, supplying the Existence Proof Format, a feasibility-question corpus with anchored answers, and a published gatekeeping eval (Japanese canonical; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20558800). It carries no `extends` edge in the hub graph because it operationalizes no Layer 4 tactic, and it is not a sibling research line (pre-line status). Beside existence-proof sits a *worked instance* of its Existence Proof Format: [einstein-arena](https://github.com/shimo4228/einstein-arena). An autonomous agent, directed by the author and run under the same approval-gated harness, reached a server-verified top score on EinsteinArena's Prime Number Theorem construction problem — the server score equals the local score to all digits (0.9955806), beating the prior published best (0.994901) by +0.00068 while holding the clean g(x) ≤ 1 bound rather than the 1.0001 tolerance the prior top spent. The author holds no degree or research background in mathematics or numerical optimization; the AI is the path and the result is the author's to account for (consistent with the AAP operator-accountability framing). It is filed as Existence Proof Format instance #1, anchored to the public repository and the arena platform; in the hub graph it is an `EcosystemRepo` linked via `isPartOf` with no `extends` edge — a witness, not a component skill and not a research line.

## What is the Attention, Not Self line?

Attention, Not Self is defined as a personal essay collection and structured knowledge graph (~238 nodes, schema.org plus a custom `ans:` vocabulary) mapping the three major Buddhist Abhidharma traditions — Theravāda, Sarvāstivāda, Yogācāra — onto contemporary frameworks in computational phenomenology. The comparative move juxtaposes ancient classifications of cognitive process (citta-vīthi, samanantara-pratyaya, ālaya-vijñāna, javana, bhavaṅga, the four bhāgas, the five sarvatraga, kṣaṇikatva, vāsanā, manas as ego-clinging, vijñaptimātratā, āśraya-parāvṛtti) with predictive processing, active inference, Global Workspace Theory, and Parallel Distributed Processing. The line's organizing perspective is *attention, not self*: attention — its allocation, its precision-weighting, its momentariness (kṣaṇikatva) — is treated as the operative unit of cognition, while the apparent self is a derivative pattern (anātman). The thesis grounds the comparative move between Abhidharma's cognitive-process classification and contemporary computational phenomenology, with mindfulness (sati), bare attention (Nyanaponika 1962), heedfulness (appamāda), and wakefulness (jāgariya) all treated as varieties of precision-weighted attention rather than properties of a persisting self. Japanese is the canonical language for this line; English README is provided for accessibility. License: CC0 1.0. Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20262112.

## What papers have been deposited from the research lines?

Position papers are deposited as standalone Zenodo records with their own concept DOIs, each belonging to one research line. The Zenodo record is canonical; SSRN mirrors exist where noted. From the AKC line: *Harness Alignment and Harness Drift: Why Intent, Unlike Correctness, Resists Automation* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20578272). From the AAP line: *Distributing Accountability, Not Capability: Phase Separation and the LLM Workflow Quadrant in Autonomous AI Agent Architectures* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20353789; SSRN abstract 6817598) and *The Two-Layer Black Box: Operator Visibility, Commercial Secrecy, and a Minimum Disclosure Set for Accountable Autonomous AI Agents* (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20355907; SSRN abstract 6823878). In the hub graph each paper is a `Paper` node attached to its line via the standard schema.org `isPartOf` property. This list is membership-only: a row is added when a paper is deposited and is never edited for routine line releases.

## Where can the long-form writing be read?

Writing refers to the long-form counterpart to the repositories — context, failures, and in-progress thinking that do not fit in code comments. The source of truth is the `zenn-content` GitHub repository (https://github.com/shimo4228/zenn-content), which holds the Markdown sources and is the form most readers clone or fork directly. Browser-readable mirrors are published on Zenn (https://zenn.dev/shimo4228, Japanese) and Dev.to (https://dev.to/shimo4228, English mirror of Zenn). Newsletter and long-form essays are also published on Substack (https://substack.com/@shimo4228). Academic working papers are cross-deposited to SSRN (author page: https://ssrn.com/author=11618068); the canonical records are the Zenodo concept DOIs linked from each line's repository.

## What is claude-harness?

The claude-harness repository is defined as a public artifact of shimo4228's daily-use Claude Code skills, agents, and rules. It bundles skills covering research-before-coding, knowledge extraction, skill auditing, AI-facing documentation, and human-facing writing review; agents for prompt generation and editorial review; and rules covering planning, the AKC cycle, and skill origin tracking. Components are mechanically collected from `~/.claude/` by the `origin: shimo4228` frontmatter tag, so ECC-derived components (`origin: ECC` or `ECC-customized`) and auto-extracted artifacts are excluded. The AKC cycle skills are also published as standalone `claude-skill-*` repositories for individual install. See the [claude-harness README](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-harness#contents) for the current inventory. License: MIT.

## What are the adjacent skills?

Adjacent skills are defined as companion Claude Code skill repositories maintained alongside the AKC cycle but not part of its six phases and not bound to any specific research line — same author, same MIT license. They exist as standalone `claude-skill-*` repos so they can be adopted independently of the AKC cycle. The current adjacent skills are [claude-skill-writing-ecosystem](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-skill-writing-ecosystem) (orchestrator for human-facing writing and review — AI-slop banned list, Voice rules, title conventions, role boundaries across article-writing / editor / essay-reviewer / fact-checker, audience-paired with `llms-txt-writer`), [daily-research](https://github.com/shimo4228/daily-research) (cron-driven daily research digest with a two-pass `claude -p` pipeline), and [claude-skill-paper-ecosystem](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-skill-paper-ecosystem) (academic paper write/review bundle for SSRN / arXiv / Zenodo / journal venues — an orchestrator skill plus a draft skill plus five reviewer agents bundled together so the skill and its agents install as one unit; it keeps the `claude-skill-` prefix because Claude Code subagents are not part of the cross-tool Agent Skills standard). In the hub graph these are registered as `EcosystemRepo` nodes without `implements` or `extends` edges — that absence is how they are distinguished both from the six AKC cycle skills (which carry `implements: six-phase-loop`) and from Authorship Strategy component skills (which carry `extends: 10.5281/zenodo.20263316`).

## What is the traffic dataset?

The traffic dataset is defined as a CC0-licensed, auto-generated companion dataset capturing daily snapshots of the GitHub Traffic API for the public research repositories. It is append-only JSONL under `traffic/data/` in the hub repository, with a small HTML/CSS dashboard at [shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/](https://shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/) rendering aggregate timelines, per-repo small multiples, and clones-to-views ratios across the tracked public research repositories. In the hub graph it is registered as a sibling `Dataset` node next to the root knowledge-graph `Dataset`; the two are independent concerns (curated structural map vs. observed usage signal), connected only through `isBasedOn` back to the hub repository. The dataset is observed data, not curated content — it does not affect the hub's design rules and is excluded from hand-edits.

## What is the probe dataset?

The probe dataset is defined as a CC0-licensed, append-only record of scheduled two-channel probes of frontier LLMs, measuring whether this program's research concepts — and the author — surface in model answers. It is the empirical instrument the Authorship Strategy line calls for in ADR-0008 (attribution diffusion runs on two channels with different time constants) and ADR-0011 (the probe protocol). It lives as append-only JSONL under `probes/data/` in the hub repository — `parametric.jsonl` (web search off, probing what models carry in their trained weights) and `retrieval.jsonl` (web search on, probing grounded citation) — surfaced on the same dashboard at [shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/](https://shimo4228.github.io/shimo4228/traffic/dashboard/). The two channels are *never blended into a single score*: a blended metric would hide which channel is failing, so the parametric-vs-retrieval contrast is itself the signal. Each probe response is scored by *deterministic regex* (auditable, reproducible at temperature 0), not by LLM judgement, on four independent detections — author named *in prose* (a handle visible only inside a cited URL does not count), project/concept named, owned DOI or URL cited, and ghost-citation (derived: the work is cited but the author is never named, the failure mode the instrument exists to catch). Rates are computed over valid rows only (probe runs that returned an API error are excluded from every denominator). In the hub graph it is registered as a sibling `Dataset` node (`#probe-dataset`) with `distribution` links to both channel files, `about` the Authorship Strategy concept DOI (10.5281/zenodo.20263316), and `isBasedOn` the hub repository. It is explicitly framed as preliminary observation, not evidence: a handful of probes across a few providers over a short window, and — by design — self-contaminating, because this public log feeds the very retrieval channel it measures.

## How do the five research lines relate?

The five lines are organized in two clusters. The three *agent-design lines* — AKC, Contemplative Agent, AAP — are mutually orthogonal and composable. AKC refers to a mechanism (a cycle architecture for sustaining intent alignment between an agent and its operator over time). Contemplative Agent refers to a disposition (a behavioral preset grounded in four axioms). AAP refers to a practice (harness-neutral judgments on how accountability is distributed across absence, scaffolding, and untrusted-boundary layers, paired with the four Business AI Quadrants). Any subset of these three is usable on its own: contemplative-agent-rules ships the axioms as a drop-in preset for any Claude Code harness, AKC skills work in projects that never touch the axioms, and AAP ADRs can be applied to an agent harness that uses neither AKC nor the four axioms. The contemplative-agent repository is the one place where all three agent-design lines land together — its operational substrate was also where the AAP judgments were first observed in practice before being re-expressed harness-neutral.

The two *cross-cutting research lines* — Authorship Strategy and Attention, Not Self — address concerns adjacent to but distinct from agent design. Authorship Strategy is the meta-line: it formalizes how the author of any research artifact (including the four other lines in this program) should think about diffusion, citation, and identity under LLM-mediated substrate change. Its empirical layer treats the other lines' own traffic data as its primary observation set; its tactical ADRs (concept DOI canonical, identifier federation, audience-driven localization, ORCID enrichment) are applied to all five lines including itself. Attention, Not Self is the philosophical-inquiry line: it sits genealogically beside the contemplative-agent line (both lines engage with non-self / anātman as a load-bearing concept) but on a different register — Contemplative Agent operationalizes contemplative axioms in an agent's runtime, while Attention, Not Self investigates Buddhist phenomenology as a comparative source for thinking about cognition itself. The two cross-cutting lines do not stand in a derivative relationship with the agent-design trilogy; they record concerns the trilogy presupposes but does not articulate.

Graph encoding: at the schema level, all five lines are connected through symmetric `siblingOf` edges only. The single inter-line `derivesFrom` edge (AAP from Contemplative Agent) is preserved as the historical record of AAP's extraction path. No dependency edges exist between the cross-cutting lines and the agent-design trilogy; their independence is deliberate and is enforced by schema absence (no `dependsOn` edge type).

## How are the lines and ecosystem repos connected as a graph?

The relationships described in prose throughout this document are also published as a machine-readable JSON-LD graph at [graph.jsonld](graph.jsonld). The graph encodes five node types (ResearchLine, EcosystemRepo, Concept, ExternalReference, Paper) and six edge types (`siblingOf`, `derivesFrom`, `definesConcept`, `extends`, `implements`, `groundedIn`). Paper nodes attach to their research line via the standard schema.org `isPartOf` property rather than a custom edge type. Each ResearchLine node also points to the fine-grained line-level `graph.jsonld` maintained in that line's own repo via the standard schema.org `subjectOf` property, so the federation is traversable graph-to-graph — the hub graph stays at membership level and never merges line-level nodes. Two design choices are load-bearing. First, the schema deliberately has no `dependsOn` edge type, so all five research lines are connected only by symmetric `siblingOf` edges — independent evolution is enforced at the schema level rather than asserted in prose. Second, the only inter-line `derivesFrom` edge runs from AAP to Contemplative Agent, recording that AAP's harness-neutral judgments were first observed in contemplative-agent's operational practice before being re-expressed stripped of project identifiers. The two cross-cutting lines (Authorship Strategy, Attention Not Self) connect to the agent-design trilogy via `siblingOf` only — neither derives from the trilogy nor depends on it. Concept DOIs and repo URLs in the graph are verbatim copies of those in this document; the graph introduces no additional sources of truth and does not encode any volatile state (no version numbers, no counts, no churning enumerations).
